nameOrigin: a feather, as used on a dart/arrow
a young bird learning to fly

pokedexEntries.x: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

pokedexEntries.or: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

pokedexEntries.y: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it’s merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

pokedexEntries.as: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it’s merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

pokedexEntries.su: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.

pokedexEntries.mo: When it’s excited, its temperature can double, spiking hormone production in its body.

pokedexEntries.us: While it’s an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you’ll be burned.

pokedexEntries.um: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

pokedexEntries.sw: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

pokedexEntries.sh: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.
